english: Control, I forgot all my training. | Control, I forgot all my training. | Control, my training is gone. All of it.

spanish: Nosotros te lo recordamos. Paso uno: respira.
lonapse_text: sortosoN et ol somadrocer. osaP onu: aripser.
english: We'll remind you. Step one: breathe. | We'll remind you. Step one: breathe. | We'll help. First step: breathe.
Control, talk to me. | Control, talk to me. | Control, say something.

spanish: Aquí estamos. Lo estás haciendo bien.
lonapse_text: íuqA somatse. oL sátse odneicah neib.
english: We're here. You're doing fine. | We're here. You're doing fine. | Here. You're doing well.
Ship, do you copy? | Ship, do you copy? | {vessel}, do you read?

spanish: Os copio. Ocupado, pero os copio.
lonapse_text: sO oipoc. odapucO, orep so oipoc.
english: Copy. Busy, but copy. | Copy. Busy, but copy. | Busy. But copy.

spanish: Control, esto no sale en los folletos.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, otse on elas ne sol sotellof.
english: Control, this isn't in the brochures. | Control, this isn't in the brochures. | Control, the brochure never mentioned this.
The brochures lie. Carry on. | The brochures lie. Carry on. | Brochures always lie. Keep going.

spanish: Control, ¿me oís? Esto hace mucho ruido.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, ¿em sío? otsE ecah ohcum odiur.
english: Control, do you hear me? It's very loud here. | Control, do you hear me? It's very loud here. | Control, can you hear me? So loud here.

spanish: Te oímos. Grita si hace falta.
lonapse_text: eT somío. atirG is ecah atlaf.
english: We hear you. Shout if you need to. | We hear you. Shout if you need to. | Loud and clear. Shout if needed.
Ship, do you need anything? | Ship, do you need anything? | {vessel}, need anything?
A bit of luck. | A bit of luck. | Some luck, please.

spanish: Os mandamos toda la que tenemos.
lonapse_text: sO somadnam adot al euq somenet.
english: Sending you all we've got. | Sending you all we've got. | All our luck is on the way.

spanish: Control, si salimos de esta, invito yo.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, is somilas ed atse, otivni oy.
english: Control, if we get out of this, drinks are on me. | Control, if we get out of this, drinks are on me. | Control, if this works, I'm buying.
Deal. Now focus. | Deal. Now focus. | Deal. Focus.
Control, how long does this last? | Control, how long does this last? | Control, how much longer?
Not long. Hold on a bit more. | Not long. Hold on a bit more. | Almost over. Hang on.

spanish: Control, creo que estoy sudando dentro del traje.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, oerc euq yotse odnadus ortned led ejart.
english: Control, I think I'm sweating inside my suit. | Control, I think I'm sweating inside my suit. | Control, my suit is getting sweaty.
Normal. So are we. | Normal. So are we. | Normal. We're sweating too.

spanish: Ojo, nave. Los datos cambian rápido.
lonapse_text: ojO, evan. soL sotad naibmac odipár.
english: Careful, ship. The data is changing fast. | Careful, ship. The data is changing fast. | Careful, {vessel}. Data moving fast.
I can feel it. I can really feel it. | I can feel it. I can really feel it. | Feeling it. Really feeling it.

spanish: Control, damos vueltas como una peonza.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, somad satleuv omoc anu aznoep.
english: Control, we're spinning like a top. | Control, we're spinning like a top. | Control, we're a spinning top.
We see it. Correct gently. | We see it. Correct gently. | Copy. Gentle corrections.
Everything's spinning. Even my breakfast. | Everything's spinning. Even my breakfast. | It all spins. My breakfast too.

spanish: Ese giro no nos gusta. Paradlo poco a poco.
lonapse_text: esE orig on son atsug. oldaraP ocop a ocop.
english: We don't like that spin. Stop it slowly. | We don't like that spin. Stop it slowly. | That spin worries us. Stop it gently.

spanish: Control, ¿cuál es el lado de arriba?
lonapse_text: lortnoC, ¿láuc se le odal ed abirra?
english: Control, which side is up? | Control, which side is up? | Control, which way is up?
Any of them. Stop the spin first. | Any of them. Stop the spin first. | Doesn't matter. Stop spinning first.
My head is spinning. | My head is spinning. | My head spins.
Even my ears feel heavy. | Even my ears feel heavy. | My ears weigh a ton.
Heavy load. Hold on, it's dropping. | Heavy load. Hold on, it's dropping. | Lots of g's. It gets better soon.

spanish: Control, me estoy hundiendo en el asiento.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, em yotse odneidnuh ne le otneisa.
english: Control, I'm sinking into my seat. | Control, I'm sinking into my seat. | Control, the seat is swallowing me.
Normal. Breathe from the belly. | Normal. Breathe from the belly. | Normal. Belly breathing.

spanish: No puedo levantar el brazo. Ni quiero.
lonapse_text: oN odeup ratnavel le ozarb. iN oreiuq.
english: I can't lift my arm. Don't want to either. | I can't lift my arm. Don't want to either. | My arm won't lift. It doesn't want to.

spanish: Control, esto tiembla como un tren viejo.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, otse albmeit omoc nu nert ojeiv.
english: Control, this shakes like an old train. | Control, this shakes like an old train. | Control, it's like an old train in here.
High pressure. It's nearly over. | High pressure. It's nearly over. | Max pressure. Almost through it.
My teeth are chattering. | My teeth are chattering. | My teeth are rattling.

spanish: Mucha presión. Suave con el acelerador.
lonapse_text: ahcuM nóiserp. evauS noc le rodareleca.
english: Lots of pressure. Easy on the throttle. | Lots of pressure. Easy on the throttle. | High pressure. Gentle throttle.
Everything's shaking. Even my thoughts. | Everything's shaking. Even my thoughts. | It all shakes. My thoughts too.

spanish: Control, el suelo tiene mucha prisa por vernos.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, le oleus eneit ahcum asirp rop sonrev.
english: Control, the ground is in a real hurry to meet us. | Control, the ground is in a real hurry to meet us. | Control, the ground wants to meet us. Fast.
We see it. Slow down now. | We see it. Slow down now. | Copy. Slow down.
Lots of ground. Very close. | Lots of ground. Very close. | So much ground. So close.

spanish: Ojo con la altura. Subid o frenad.
lonapse_text: ojO noc al arutla. dibuS o danerf.
english: Watch your altitude. Climb or slow down. | Watch your altitude. Climb or slow down. | Mind the altitude. Climb or brake.

spanish: Control, prefiero el suelo un poco más lejos.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, oreiferp le oleus nu ocop sám sojel.
english: Control, I'd like the ground a bit further away. | Control, I'd like the ground a bit further away. | Control, can the ground move back a little?
So would we. Correct. | So would we. Correct. | Us too. Correct it.

spanish: Control, aquí dentro hace calor. Mucho calor.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, íuqa ortned ecah rolac. ohcuM rolac.
english: Control, it's hot in here. Very hot. | Control, it's hot in here. Very hot. | Control, very hot in here.
We see it. The shield is holding. | We see it. The shield is holding. | Copy. The shield holds.

spanish: Huele a tostada. Y no hay tostadas.
lonapse_text: eleuH a adatsot. Y on yah sadatsot.
english: It smells like toast. And there's no toast. | It smells like toast. And there's no toast. | Smells like toast. No toast here.

spanish: La temperatura sube. Vigilad las piezas.
lonapse_text: aL arutarepmet ebus. daligiV sal sazeip.
english: Temperature's rising. Watch the parts. | Temperature's rising. Watch the parts. | It's getting hotter. Watch the parts.

spanish: El casco está caliente. No me gusta.
lonapse_text: lE ocsac átse etneilac. oN em atsug.
english: The hull is hot. I don't like it. | The hull is hot. I don't like it. | Hot hull. Not a fan.

spanish: Control, fuera todo brilla como un horno.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, areuf odot allirb omoc nu onroh.
english: Control, it's glowing like an oven outside. | Control, it's glowing like an oven outside. | Control, it's an oven out there.

spanish: Es el plasma. Normal. Casi normal.
lonapse_text: sE le amsalp. lamroN. isaC lamron.
english: That's the plasma. Normal. Almost normal. | That's the plasma. Normal. Almost normal. | Plasma. Normal. Mostly.

spanish: La ventana brilla mucho. Muy naranja.
lonapse_text: aL anatnev allirb ohcum. yuM ajnaran.
english: The window is glowing. Very orange. | The window is glowing. Very orange. | Very orange window.

spanish: Vais a perder la radio pronto. Os esperamos al otro lado.
lonapse_text: siaV a redrep al oidar otnorp. sO somarepse la orto odal.
english: You'll lose the radio soon. We'll wait for you on the other side. | You'll lose the radio soon. We'll wait for you on the other side. | Radio goes quiet soon. See you on the other side.

spanish: Control, el indicador de combustible no para de bajar.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, le rodacidni ed elbitsubmoc on arap ed rajab.
english: Control, the fuel gauge won't stop dropping. | Control, the fuel gauge won't stop dropping. | Control, the fuel keeps dropping.

spanish: Lo vemos. Nada de gastos extra.
lonapse_text: oL somev. adaN ed sotsag artxe.
english: We see it. No extra spending. | We see it. No extra spending. | Copy. No wasting fuel.
Only a few drops left. Very few. | Only a few drops left. Very few. | A few drops. That's it.
Fuel is tight. Every drop counts. | Fuel is tight. Every drop counts. | Tight on fuel. Every drop matters.

spanish: Control, ¿cuánto se puede andar con un depósito vacío?
lonapse_text: lortnoC, ¿otnáuc es edeup radna noc nu otisóped oícav?
english: Control, how far can you go on an empty tank? | Control, how far can you go on an empty tank? | Control, how far does an empty tank get us?
Nowhere. Don't try it. | Nowhere. Don't try it. | Not far. Don't test it.
Oof! I felt that bump. | Oof! I felt that bump. | Oof! That bump!
So did we. All good? | So did we. All good? | We felt it too. Okay?
I think so. | I think so. | Probably.
Something jerked. | Something jerked. | Something jolted.
Lots of movement. Hold on tight. | Lots of movement. Hold on tight. | Big movements. Hang on.

spanish: Me he dado con la cabeza en el panel.
lonapse_text: eM eh odad noc al azebac ne le lenap.
english: I bumped my head on the panel. | I bumped my head on the panel. | Ow. My head hit the panel.

spanish: Control, el motor se ha callado.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, le rotom es ah odallac.
english: Control, the engine went quiet. | Control, the engine went quiet. | Control, engine is silent.

spanish: Lo vemos. Seguid la lista de fallos.
lonapse_text: oL somev. diugeS al atsil ed sollaf.
english: We see it. Follow the failure checklist. | We see it. Follow the failure checklist. | Copy. Failure checklist.

spanish: Sin motor. Esto se pone interesante.
lonapse_text: niS rotom. otsE es enop etnaseretni.
english: No engine. This is getting interesting. | No engine. This is getting interesting. | Engine's gone. Interesting.
Engine out. Calm, we have options. | Engine out. Calm, we have options. | Lost the engine. We still have options.

spanish: Control, ¿alguien ha visto el motor? Ya no suena.
lonapse_text: lortnoC, ¿neiugla ah otsiv le rotom? aY on aneus.
english: Control, has anyone seen the engine? It's not making noise anymore. | Control, has anyone seen the engine? It's not making noise anymore. | Control, the engine stopped humming. Seen it anywhere?

spanish: Comprobad el combustible y la etapa.
lonapse_text: daborpmoC le elbitsubmoc y al apate.
english: Check the fuel and the stage. | Check the fuel and the stage. | Look at fuel and staging.
Does this shake a lot at liftoff? | Is liftoff bumpy?
A bit. Hold on and breathe.
Okay. Hold on to what?
Where's the bathroom? | Is there a bathroom?

spanish: Buena pregunta. Tenías que haber ido antes.
lonapse_text: aneuB atnugerp. saíneT euq rebah odi setna.
english: Good question. You should have gone before.
Does that red button do anything? | What does the red button do?

spanish: Sí. Por eso nadie lo toca.
lonapse_text: íS. roP ose eidan ol acot.
english: Yes. That's why nobody touches it.
Just asking.
Who's driving right now?

spanish: Nadie. En órbita la nave va sola.
lonapse_text: eidaN. nE atibró al evan av alos.
english: Nobody. In orbit the ship flies itself.
That doesn't calm me down at all.
Can I open the window for a second?
No. Never. Please.
How much longer? | Are we there yet?
A while. Look at the stars.
I've looked at all of them.
My stomach is floating.

spanish: Es normal. Mira un punto fijo.
lonapse_text: sE lamron. ariM nu otnup ojif.
english: That's normal. Look at a fixed point.

spanish: Aquí todo se mueve. No hay puntos fijos.
lonapse_text: íuqA odot es eveum. oN yah sotnup sojif.
english: Everything moves up here. There are no fixed points.

spanish: ¿Me haces una foto con la ventana?
lonapse_text: ¿eM secah anu otof noc al anatnev?
english: Can you take my photo by the window?
I'm working.

spanish: Solo una. Es para mi madre.
lonapse_text: oloS anu. sE arap im erdam.
english: Just one. It's for my mother.
Fine. Smile.
Can I go out for a walk?

spanish: Los pasajeros se quedan dentro. Está en el contrato.
lonapse_text: soL sorejasap es nadeuq ortned. átsE ne le otartnoc.
english: Passengers stay inside. It's in the contract.
Nobody reads contracts.
Do they sell souvenirs here?

spanish: Aquí no hay nadie. Ni tiendas.
lonapse_text: íuqA on yah eidan. iN sadneit.
english: There's nobody here. No shops either.
Why do you do so much math?
To get back home.
Then keep going, keep going.
What do I do if I get bored?

spanish: No tocar nada. Eso ya es mucho.
lonapse_text: oN racot adan. osE ay se ohcum.
english: Don't touch anything. That's plenty.
Is this a real seatbelt?
Yes. Tighter.
Any tighter and I can't breathe.

spanish: Desde aquí no veo mi casa.
lonapse_text: edseD íuqa on oev im asac.
english: I can't see my house from here.

spanish: Estamos sobre el agua. Espera una vuelta.
lonapse_text: somatsE erbos le auga. arepsE anu atleuv.
english: We're over water. Wait one orbit.
Why is the window orange?

spanish: Es el calor de la entrada. Es normal.
lonapse_text: sE le rolac ed al adartne. sE lamron.
english: That's reentry heat. It's normal.

spanish: Nadie me dijo que eso fuera normal.
lonapse_text: eidaN em ojid euq ose areuf lamron.
english: Nobody told me that was normal.
Can't Control hear us anymore?

spanish: Durante un rato no. Luego vuelven.
lonapse_text: etnaruD nu otar on. ogeuL nevleuv.
english: Not for a while. They'll be back.

spanish: Pues luego diles que me porto bien.
lonapse_text: seuP ogeul selid euq em otrop neib.
english: Then tell them later that I behaved.
Do they pay you for this?
Not much. And you paid to come?
A fortune.
Can I press something? A small one.

spanish: Ese de ahí. No hace nada.
lonapse_text: esE ed íha. oN ecah adan.
english: That one there. It does nothing.
How exciting!
It's really hot in here!
Hold on. It's almost over.

spanish: ¿Por qué damos vueltas? ¿Es parte del viaje?
lonapse_text: ¿roP éuq somad satleuv? ¿sE etrap led ejaiv?
english: Why are we spinning? Is this part of the trip?
No. But I'm fixing it.
I can't lift my arms.
Don't even try. It'll ease off.
What was that bang?
Nothing serious. Sit down.

spanish: Ya lo estoy. Más que nunca.
lonapse_text: aY ol yotse. sáM euq acnun.
english: I am. More than ever.
Does this happen on every trip?
On the good ones, yes.
I want to get off. Where's the stop?
There are no stops. Breathe.
First time on a rocket?
First time out of the house.

spanish: Ese panel no se toca, por favor.
lonapse_text: esE lenap on es acot, rop rovaf.
english: Please don't touch that panel.

spanish: No lo toco. Solo lo miro de cerca.
lonapse_text: oN ol ocot. oloS ol orim ed acrec.
english: I'm not touching it. Just looking closely.
From farther away.

spanish: Mira por la ventana. ¿Qué te parece?
lonapse_text: ariM rop al anatnev. ¿éuQ et ecerap?
english: Look out the window. What do you think?
That it was worth the money.
Are you okay? You don't look well.

spanish: Floto y tengo mala cara. Todo nuevo para mí.
lonapse_text: otolF y ognet alam arac. odoT oveun arap ím.
english: I'm floating and I look bad. All new to me.
There's a bag right there.
If you need anything, ask.
Are there any movies?
There's a window.

spanish: Cuando empiece a temblar, no grites.
lonapse_text: odnauC eceipme a ralbmet, on setirg.
english: When it starts shaking, don't scream.
And if I scream a little?
A little is fine.
Stop spinning the seat.

spanish: El asiento no gira. Giro yo.
lonapse_text: lE otneisa on arig. oriG oy.
english: The seat isn't spinning. I am.

spanish: Te doy la bienvenida a otro mundo.
lonapse_text: eT yod al adinevneib a orto odnum.
english: Welcome to another world.

spanish: Huele igual que el de antes.
lonapse_text: eleuH laugi euq le ed setna.
english: It smells just like the old one.
Strap in when you sleep.
So I don't fall?

spanish: Para no despertar flotando en la cocina.
lonapse_text: araP on ratrepsed odnatolf ne al anicoc.
english: So you don't wake up floating in the galley.

spanish: Tu comida está en el cajón azul.
lonapse_text: uT adimoc átse ne le nójac luza.
english: Your food is in the blue drawer.

spanish: ¿Esto es comida? Pensaba que era pasta de dientes.
lonapse_text: ¿otsE se adimoc? abasneP euq are atsap ed setneid.
english: This is food? I thought it was toothpaste.

spanish: Respira despacio. El mareo se pasa.
lonapse_text: aripseR oicapsed. lE oeram es asap.
english: Breathe slowly. The sickness passes.
When?
Roughly when we land.

spanish: No salgas. Lo digo en serio.
lonapse_text: oN saglas. oL ogid ne oires.
english: Don't go outside. I mean it.

spanish: Ni siquiera sé abrir la puerta.
lonapse_text: iN areiuqis és rirba al atreup.
english: I don't even know how to open the door.
Better that way.
What will you tell everyone when you get back?
That I was flying it.
Of course you were.

spanish: Ahora se calienta todo. Con calma.
lonapse_text: arohA es atneilac odot. noC amlac.
english: Now everything heats up. Stay calm.
I'm calm. On the outside.

spanish: Las manos en las rodillas, por favor.
lonapse_text: saL sonam ne sal sallidor, rop rovaf.
english: Hands on your knees, please.

spanish: ¿En las mías o en las tuyas?
lonapse_text: ¿nE sal saím o ne sal sayut?
english: Mine or yours?

spanish: Ese ruido es el ventilador. No pasa nada.
lonapse_text: esE odiur se le rodalitnev. oN asap adan.
english: That noise is the fan. Nothing's wrong.

spanish: Llevo una hora con miedo a un ventilador.
lonapse_text: ovelL anu aroh noc odeim a nu rodalitnev.
english: I've been scared of a fan for an hour.

spanish: Esto es fuerte, pero está previsto.
lonapse_text: otsE se etreuf, orep átse otsiverp.
english: This is rough, but it's planned.
Planned by whom?
By very smart people. I think.
We're spinning. Close your eyes.

spanish: Con los ojos cerrados giro más.
lonapse_text: noC sol sojo sodarrec orig sám.
english: With my eyes closed I spin more.

spanish: Vas a notar mucho peso. Es normal.
lonapse_text: saV a raton ohcum osep. sE lamron.
english: You'll feel very heavy. That's normal.

spanish: Me siento como un saco de patatas.
lonapse_text: eM otneis omoc nu ocas ed satatap.
english: I feel like a sack of potatoes.

spanish: ¿Estás bien? Eso ha sido un golpe.
lonapse_text: ¿sátsE neib? osE ah odis nu eplog.
english: Are you okay? That was a bump.

spanish: Me he mordido la lengua. Y el bocadillo.
lonapse_text: eM eh odidrom al augnel. Y le ollidacob.
english: I bit my tongue. And my sandwich.

spanish: Mírame a mí, no a la ventana.
lonapse_text: emaríM a ím, on a al anatnev.
english: Look at me, not at the window.
Your face doesn't calm me down either.
Let go of that lever. Slowly.
This one? Done. What did it do?
Better you don't know.
Did you buy the full package too?
No. The basic one. No window.

spanish: Te dejo mirar por la mía.
lonapse_text: eT ojed rarim rop al aím.
english: You can look through mine.

spanish: ¿Eso de ahí es una estrella o un botón?
lonapse_text: ¿osE ed íha se anu allertse o nu nótob?
english: Is that a star or a button?

spanish: Un botón. Las estrellas están fuera.
lonapse_text: nU nótob. saL sallertse nátse areuf.
english: A button. The stars are outside.
Look, I'm floating upside down.

spanish: Aquí no hay abajo. Lo ha dicho la tripulación.
lonapse_text: íuqA on yah ojaba. oL ah ohcid al nóicalupirt.
english: There's no down up here. The crew said so.
Then I'm floating right side up.

spanish: ¿Crees que nos dejarán conducir un poco?
lonapse_text: ¿seerC euq son nárajed ricudnoc nu ocop?
english: Do you think they'll let us drive a bit?

spanish: Yo ya pregunté. Se rieron mucho.
lonapse_text: oY ay étnugerp. eS noreir ohcum.
english: I already asked. They laughed a lot.
I ate your dessert.
That was my dinner.
Well, it was delicious.
How many photos have you taken?

spanish: Cuatrocientas. Casi todas de la ventana.
lonapse_text: satneicortauC. isaC sadot ed al anatnev.
english: Four hundred. Almost all of the window.

spanish: Yo tengo cuatrocientas tuyas mirando la ventana.
lonapse_text: oY ognet satneicortauc sayut odnarim al anatnev.
english: I have four hundred of you looking at the window.
Are we there?

spanish: Creo que sí. Ya no se mueve nada.
lonapse_text: oerC euq ís. aY on es eveum adan.
english: I think so. Nothing's moving anymore.

spanish: Qué pena. Ahora que me gustaba.
lonapse_text: éuQ anep. arohA euq em abatsug.
english: Shame. Just when I liked it.
There's nothing here.
That's why it's so expensive.

spanish: ¿Entiendes algo de lo que dicen por la radio?
lonapse_text: ¿sedneitnE ogla ed ol euq necid rop al oidar?
english: Do you understand anything they say on the radio?

spanish: Solo la palabra recibido. La dicen mucho.
lonapse_text: oloS al arbalap odibicer. aL necid ohcum.
english: Just the word copy. They say it a lot.

spanish: Si me desmayo, despiértame para la foto.
lonapse_text: iS em oyamsed, ematréipsed arap al otof.
english: If I faint, wake me up for the photo.

spanish: Si me desmayo yo, haz la foto igual.
lonapse_text: iS em oyamsed oy, zah al otof laugi.
english: If I faint, take the photo anyway.

spanish: El folleto decía que había vistas.
lonapse_text: lE otellof aíced euq aíbah satsiv.
english: The brochure said there'd be a view.
There is a view.
It said a view with snacks.
Do you get sick?
Only when you look at me like that.
I'm going to write a review.
How many stars?

spanish: Todas las que veo. Son muchas.
lonapse_text: sadoT sal euq oev. noS sahcum.
english: All the ones I can see. That's a lot.

spanish: ¿Sabes qué hace la tripulación todo el día?
lonapse_text: ¿sebaS éuq ecah al nóicalupirt odot le aíd?
english: Do you know what the crew does all day?
